I've reviewed section 14 more closely—the 90-day notice is actually a mutual provision, but the automatic renewal clause underneath it is what creates the real lock-in risk. Unless we give 60 days' written notice before the annual term ends, it rolls forward for another full year under the same terms. 

Given our headcount uncertainty, I recommend we negotiate for a shorter initial term with explicit renewal elections rather than automatic rollover. I'm also flagging that the liability cap language in section 12 references "direct damages" without excluding consequential damages—this conflicts with our standard risk posture and needs alignment with whatever cap structure their counsel proposes.
